prompt: Create a custom structural directive in Angular called `*appRepeat` that repeats its template a given number of times and exposes the current index as an implicit context variable. Full implementation using TemplateRef and ViewContainerRef with the modern inject() function.

assertions.name: uses_inject_function
assertions.description: Uses inject(TemplateRef) and inject(ViewContainerRef) instead of constructor injection

assertions.name: exposes_implicit_context
assertions.description: Sets $implicit in the context to expose index to template

assertions.name: handles_changes
assertions.description: Clears and recreates views when input changes, or uses effect/setter
